_note: Words on the App Store creative asset (product page header and search results, one 16:9 image per locale). Same voice as shot-captions.json: say what the app does, plainly. A newline in `title` is a line break. It says the whole product: every tmux session on the Mac, agents the richest of them, and HQ over all of them. Apple's rules for these assets: 4+, no prices, URLs, copyright marks, other platforms' logos or Apple awards; localize every language the listing has. `ipad` and `phone` are raw captures from the demo harness (iPad Pro 13" landscape, iPhone 6.9"); `dot` is a status colour (DESIGN §9).

en.sub: Agents come to you when they need you. HQ watches them all and catches you up.
